abstract: AIM: To evaluate relapse patterns in stage I testicular seminoma related to changes in radiotherapy practice. METHOD: Four hundred and six patients with stage I testicular seminoma were treated with adjuvant radiotherapy following orchidectomy: 338 patients received para-aortic radiotherapy only and 68 patients with added risk factors had radiotherapy extended to include the pelvis. Computed tomograms of relapsed patients were reviewed and sites of relapse were documented with correlation to the radiotherapy field. RESULTS: Thirteen relapses were identified; 10 occurring in the para-aortic radiotherapy group (3.0% relapse rate) and three in the extended radiotherapy field group (4.4% relapse rate). Sites of relapse were; five pelvis, three mediastinum, one lung, one scapula, one scrotum, while one patient had multiple relapse sites including the pelvis and one had a tumour marker relapse with no site identified. All the pelvic relapses occurred in the para-aortic radiotherapy group. CONCLUSION: Pelvic relapse only occurred when radiotherapy had been confined to the para-aortic region. Since para-aortic radiotherapy achieves equivalent outcome to wider field radiotherapy with reduced toxicity, it is likely to become standard practice in stage I seminoma and pelvic relapses will therefore increase in frequency. It is therefore important to include pelvic imaging when relapse is suspected.
abstract_ja:
目的: 放射線療法の実施方法の変化に関連した、病期I精巣セミノーマの再発パターンを評価すること。
方法: 精巣摘除後に補助放射線療法を受けた病期I精巣セミノーマ406例を対象とした。338例は傍大動脈放射線療法のみを受け、危険因子を有する68例では骨盤を含むよう照射野を拡大した。再発患者のCTを見直し、再発部位を放射線照射野との関係で記録した。
結果: 13例の再発を認めた。傍大動脈放射線療法群では10例(再発率3.0%)、拡大照射野群では3例(再発率4.4%)であった。再発部位は骨盤5例、縦隔3例、肺1例、肩甲骨1例、陰嚢1例で、1例は骨盤を含む複数部位の再発、1例は部位不明の腫瘍マーカー再発であった。すべての骨盤再発は傍大動脈放射線療法群で生じた。
結論: 骨盤再発は放射線療法が傍大動脈領域に限定された場合にのみ生じた。傍大動脈放射線療法は、より広い照射野の放射線療法と同等の成績を毒性を抑えて達成するため、病期Iセミノーマの標準的治療となる可能性が高く、今後骨盤再発は増加すると考えられる。再発が疑われる場合には骨盤の画像検査を含めることが重要である。
